40018788.author: पदार्थः
40018788.content: ततः then, दैवतैः Devatas, समागम्य collected together, रणम् war, द्रष्टुम् seeing, अभ्यागतः came, भगवान् god, अगस्त्यऋषिः Agastya Risi, युद्धपरिश्रान्तम् duly prepared, युद्धाय for war, समुपस्थितम् come and stood, रावणम् Ravana, अग्रतः before, दृष्टवा seeing, समरे in war, चिन्तया thinking, स्थितम् stood, रामम् Rama, उपगम्य had come, अब्रवीत् spoke as follows

40018788.author: Translation
40018788.content: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.

40018789.author: पदार्थः
40018789.content: ततः then, दैवतैः Devatas, समागम्य collected together, रणम् war, द्रष्टुम् seeing, अभ्यागतः came, भगवान् god, अगस्त्यऋषिः Agastya Risi, युद्धपरिश्रान्तम् duly prepared, युद्धाय for war, समुपस्थितम् come and stood, रावणम् Ravana, अग्रतः before, दृष्टवा seeing, समरे in war, चिन्तया thinking, स्थितम् stood, रामम् Rama, उपगम्य had come, अब्रवीत् spoke as follows

40018789.author: Translation
40018789.content: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.

40018789.author: सारांशः
40018789.content: Sage Agastya arrives and advises Rama to chant 'Aditya Hrdaya' verses in praise of Sun god for success.

40018790.author: पदार्थः
40018790.content: महाबाहो mighty armed, रामराम Rama Rama, सनातनम् eternal, गुह्यम् secret, शृणु hear, वत्स dear, येन because, समरे in war, सर्वान् all, अरीन् enemies, विजयिष्यसे which will enable you to win

40018790.author: Translation
40018790.content: "O mighty armed Sri Rama! Dear, hear this eternal secret (mantra) which will enable you to win all the enemies in war."

40018791.author: पदार्थः
40018791.content: पुण्यम् sacred, सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् which can destroy all enemies, जयावहम् bring victory, अक्षय्यम् eternal, परमंशिवम् very auspicious, सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यम् supremely blessed for all and prolongs life, सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्root out sins, चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनम् remove anxiety, उत्तमम् excellent, आयुर्वर्थनम् prolongs life, आदित्यहृदयम् Aditya Hridayam, नित्यम् always, जपेत् bring victory

40018791.author: Translation
40018791.content: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

40018792.author: पदार्थः
40018792.content: पुण्यम् sacred, सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् which can destroy all enemies, जयावहम् bring victory, अक्षय्यम् eternal, परमंशिवम् very auspicious, सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यम् supremely blessed for all and prolongs life, सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्root out sins, चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनम् remove anxiety, उत्तमम् excellent, आयुर्वर्थनम् prolongs life, आदित्यहृदयम् Aditya Hridayam, नित्यम् always, जपेत् bring victory

40018792.author: Translation
40018792.content: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

40018793.author: पदार्थः
40018793.content: रस्मीमन्तम् crowned with rays, समुद्यन्तम् rising up at the horizon, देवासुरनमस्कृत्य greeted by gods and demons, विवस्वन्तम् bring light, भास्करम् sun god, भुवनेश्वरम् embodiment of all gods, पूजयस्वworship

40018793.author: Translation
40018793.content: "You worship the Sun God, crowned with rays rising up at the horizon, greeted by all gods and demons, who brings light to all and who is the embodiment of all gods."

40018794.author: पदार्थः
40018794.content: एषः he is, सर्वदेवात्मकः self in all, तेजस्वी glorious, रस्मीभावनः by his rays, एषः he in that way, गभस्तिभिः ray of light, देवासुरगणान् for gods and suras, लोकान् for the world, पाति Lord

40018794.author: Translation
40018794.content: "He is the self in all, glorious, he sustains by his rays of light, the gods, suras and the whole world. He is the Lord of all.

40018795.author: पदार्थः
40018795.content: एषः in the same way, ब्रह्मा च Brahma, the creator, विष्णुश्च Vishnu also, शिवः Siva also, स्कन्धः Skanda, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, महेन्द्र Mahendra, धनदः Kubera, कालः Time spirit, यमः Yama, सोमः Soma, अपांपतिः Varuna

40018795.author: Translation
40018795.content: "In the same way, he is the body of Brahma the creator, he is Vishnu also, Shiva also, S Kanda, Prajapati, Mahendra, Kubera, time spirit, Yama, Soma, and Varuna also.

40018796.author: पदार्थः
40018796.content: पितरः manes, वसवः Vasava, साध्याः Sadhyas, अश्विनौ Aswinis, मरुतः Marutha, मनुः Manu, वायुः Wind god, वह्निः god of fire, प्रजाः for beings, प्राणः life, ऋतुकर्ता god of seasons, प्रभाकरः Sun god

40018796.author: Translation
40018796.content: "He is the god of manes, Vasava, Sadhayas, Aswins, Marutha, Manu, wind god, fire god, life of all beings and god of all seasons.

40018797.author: पदार्थः
40018797.content: आदित्यः Aditya, सविता Savitha, सूर्यः Sun, खगः sky, पूषा sustainer, गभस्तिमान् rays of light, सुवर्णसदृशः of golden effulgence, भानुः Bhanu, हिरण्यरेताः shining with golden rays, दिवाकरः Sun god

40018797.author: Translation
40018797.content: "You are the son of Aditi, the sungod, creator Savitha, the courser in the heavens, the sustainer, the possessor of golden rays, Bhanu, shining with golden rays, the Sun god.

40018798.author: पदार्थः
40018798.content: हरिदश्वः possessor of green horses, सहस्रार्चिः of thousand rays, सप्तसप्तिः having horse Sapta, मरीचिमान् destroyer of darkness, तिमिरोन्मथनः mitigator of the suffering of devotees, शम्भु: giver of happiness, त्वष्टा destroyer of all names and forms, मार्तण्डकः the infuser of life in the cosmic egg, अंशुमान् all pervading

40018798.author: Translation
40018798.content: "You are the possessor of seven green horses, having a thousand rays, having horse Sapta, destroyer of darkness, mitigator of the suffering of all devotees, giver of happiness, destroyer of all names and forms, the infuser of life in the cosmic egg and having the allpervading rays.

40018799.author: पदार्थः
40018799.content: हिरण्यगर्भः having golden cosmic egg in the womb, शिशिरः cool, तपनः purifier, भास्करः ruler of all, रविः bringer of day, अग्निगर्भः Bears dissolution in the womb, अदितेः son of Aditi, पुत्रः son, शङ्खः bliss personified, शिशिरनाशनः destroyer of cold

40018799.author: Translation
40018799.content: "You have the golden cosmic egg in the womb, you are cool, you are the purifier, the ruler of all, bringer of day, who Bears the fire of dissolution in the womb. You are the son of Aditi, blissful personified and destroyer of cold.

40018800.author: पदार्थः
40018800.content: व्योमनाथः Lord of the sky,, तमोभेदी dispeller of darkness, ऋग्यजुसामपारगः the master of the three Vedas, Rig, Yajur and Sama vedas, घनवृष्टिः sender of rain, अपाम् of water, मित्रः friend, विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly

40018800.author: Translation
40018800.content: "You are the Lord of the sky, dispeller of darkness, the master of the three VedasRig, Yajur and Sama, the sender of rain, the friend of water and the courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly.

40018801.author: पदार्थः
40018801.content: आतपी possessor of heat, मण्डले circle of rays, मृत्युः killer of all enemies, पिङ्गलः tawny, सर्वतापनः destroyer of all, कविः creator, विश्वः omniscient, महातेजाः resplendant, रक्तः lover of all devotees, सर्वभवोद्भवः source of all evolutes

40018801.author: Translation
40018801.content: "You are the possessor of heat, adorned with a circle of rays. You are killer of all enemies, tawny destroyer of all, omniscient, lover of all devotees and source of all evolutes.

40018802.author: पदार्थः
40018802.content: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणाम् stars, planets, विश्वभावनः creator of all, तेजसामपि resplendent, तेजस्वी among the splendid, द्वादशात्मन् of twelve faces, ते you, नमः hail, अस्तु to you

40018802.author: Translation
40018802.content: "You are the Lord of all stars and planets. You are the creator of all, resplendent among the splendid, the twelve faces of twelve months. Hail to you.

40018803.author: पदार्थः
40018803.content: पूर्वायगिरये on the east mountain, नमः hail to you, पश्चिमायअद्रये setting in the west, नमः hail to you, दिनाधिपतयेः Lord of luminaries, नमः hail to you

40018803.author: Translation
40018803.content: "Hail to you, rising on the east mountain, setting in the west. Hail to the Lord of all luminaries.

40018804.author: पदार्थः
40018804.content: जयाय giver of victory, जयभद्राय joy born of victory, हर्यश्वाय god having green horses, नमःनमः hail to you hail to you, आदित्याय Aditya, नमःनमः namaskar, namaskar

40018804.author: Translation
40018804.content: "Namaskar, Namaskar to the giver of victory, joy born of victory, god having green horses. Hail to you Aditya.

40018805.author: पदार्थः
40018805.content: उग्राय of terrible form, वीराय valiant, नमः hail to you, सारङ्गाय denoted by syllable AUM, नमःनमः namaskar namaskar, पद्मप्रबोधाय awakener of lotus, नमः namaskar, मार्ताण्डाय the fierce one, ते to you, नमः namaskar, अस्तु be

40018805.author: Translation
40018805.content: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.

40018806.author: पदार्थः
40018806.content: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, सूर्याय Sun god, आदित्यवर्चसे the spiritual light in dwelling, भास्वते in solar orbit, सर्वभक्षाय consumer of all, रौद्रायवपुषे appearing in the form of Rudra, नमः namaskar

40018806.author: Translation
40018806.content: "Namskar to you, the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, to you the Sun god, the spiritual dwelling light in solar orbit, the consumer of all appearing in the form of Rudra.

40018807.author: पदार्थः
40018807.content: तमोघ्नाय dispeller of darkness, हिमघ्नाय dispeller of cold, शत्रुघ्नाय dispeller of enemies, अमितात्मने whose extent is immeasurable, कृतघ्नघ्नाय destroyer of the ungrateful, देवाय god, ज्योतिषाम् ruler of lights, पतये Lord of all, नमः namaskar

40018807.author: Translation
40018807.content: "You are the dispeller of darkness, dispeller of cold, dispeller of enemies, your extent is immeasurable. You are the destroyer of the ungrateful, the ruler of lights, the Lord of all and namaskar to you.

40018808.author: पदार्थः
40018808.content: तप्तचामीकराभाय possessing lustre of pure gold, हरये dispeller of ignorance,, विश्वकर्मण architect of the universe, तमोभिनिघ्नाय splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, रुचये splendor, लोकसाक्षिणे witnessor of all actions in the world, नमः namaskar

40018808.author: Translation
40018808.content: "Namaskar to one possessing the lustre of pure gold, dispeller of darkness, architect of the universe, splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, witnessor of all actions in the world.

40018809.author: पदार्थः
40018809.content: प्रभुः Lord, एषःचै being so, भूतम् beings, नाशयति destroys, तदेव this god, सृजति creates, एषः he alone, गभस्तिभिः radiates, पायति thirst, एषः he alone, तपति heats, एषः he alone, वर्षति rains

40018809.author: Translation
40018809.content: "Being a creator and destroyer of the world, this Sun god alone radiates, creates thirst by heat and rains to relieve.

40018810.author: पदार्थः
40018810.content: एषः he alone, भूतेषु among beings, सुप्तेषु in sleep, परिनिष्ठितः pervades, जागर्ति awake, एषःचैव he alone, अग्निहोत्रं च is fire sacrifice, अग्निहोत्रिणाम् of fire sacrifice, फलं च fruits

40018810.author: Translation
40018810.content: "He alone pervades the created beings and remains awake in sleep. He alone is the fire sacrifice as well as the fruits obtained from fire sacrifice.

40018811.author: पदार्थः
40018811.content: वेदश्च vedas, क्रतवश्चैव sacrifices, क्रतूनाम् of the sacrifices, फलमेव च results, सर्वेषु all, लोकेषु in the worlds, यानि he alone, कृत्यानि of all actions, परमप्रभुः supreme controller

40018811.author: Translation
40018811.content: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.

40018812.author: पदार्थः
40018812.content: राघव Raghava, एनम् any one, आपत्सु in straits, कृच्छ्रेषु in difficulties, कान्तारेषु in the woods, भयेषु in times of fear, कीर्तयन् praise, पुरुषः men, कश्चित् surely, नावसीदति will experience grief

40018812.author: Translation
40018812.content: "O Raghava! Anyone praying to him will surely not experience grief in straits, in difficulties, in the woods and in times of fear.

40018813.author: पदार्थः
40018813.content: जगत्पतिम् Lord of the universe, देवदेवम् Lord of Lords, एनम् him alone, एकाग्रः with concentration, पूजयस्व if you offer prayers, एतत् by that, त्रिगुणितम् three times of the day, जप्त्वा chant, युद्धेषु in war, विजयिष्यसि will attain victory

40018813.author: Translation
40018813.content: "Worship the Lord of the universe, the Lord of Lords. Worship him alone with concentration of mind, three times of the day by chanting his name. You will attain victory in war."

40018814.author: पदार्थः
40018814.content: महाबाहो mighty armed, अस्मिन् your, क्षणे this very moment, थ्वम् you, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्यसि will kill, अगस्त्यः Agastya, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, यथागतम् left in the same way जगाम went

40018814.author: Translation
40018814.content: Agastya having spoken in that way to the mighty armed Rama to worship the Sun God and assuring him that the very moment he will be able to kill Ravana, left in the same way.

40018815.author: पदार्थः
40018815.content: तदा then, महातेजः extraordinary energy, एतत् being, श्रुत्वा having heard, नष्टशोकः stopped worry, अभवत् became, राघवः Raghava, सुप्रीतः very affectionately, प्रयतात्मवान् greatly delighted, धारयमास remembered and chanted Aditya in his mind

40018815.author: Translation
40018815.content: Then Rama endowed with extra ordinary energy having heard Agastya, was very delighted and stopped worry. He remembered Aditya and chanted in his mind.

40018816.author: पदार्थः
40018816.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, आदित्यम् Aditya, प्रेक्ष्य looking, त्रिः three times, आचम्य sipping water, शुचिः clean, भूत्वा with devotion, जप्त्वा chanted, परम् supreme, हर्षम् delight, अवाप्तवान् getting purified, धनुः bow, आदाय took up, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य fixing his eyes, हृष्टात्मा delighted, युद्धार्थम् for the war, समुपागमत् advanced, महता great, सर्वयत्नेन with allout effort, तस्य his, वधे destruction, धृतः determined, भवत् became

40018816.author: Translation
40018816.content: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.

40018817.author: पदार्थः
40018817.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, आदित्यम् Aditya, प्रेक्ष्य looking, त्रिः three times, आचम्य sipping water, शुचिः clean, भूत्वा with devotion, जप्त्वा chanted, परम् supreme, हर्षम् delight, अवाप्तवान् getting purified, धनुः bow, आदाय took up, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य fixing his eyes, हृष्टात्मा delighted, युद्धार्थम् for the war, समुपागमत् advanced, महता great, सर्वयत्नेन with allout effort, तस्य his, वधे destruction, धृतः determined, भवत् became

40018817.author: Translation
40018817.content: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.
